contracts.title: Core Ring Tier 1 + Minimum Shelf/MCP Windows proof

authoritySources.authority: WV-6 begins after Core Ring Tier 1 and the MCP library ship.
The current Minimum Shelf lane owns the bounded in-process tool, raw-byte stdio, sealed baseline, reject-without-seal proof, and deterministic reporter.

entryConditions: Core Ring Tier 1 is frozen without widening into hosted registry infrastructure.
One bounded in-process Garnet MCP tool and raw-byte stdio lifecycle exist.
One sealed baseline and reject-without-seal trap exist before Windows recording.

requiredChecks.criterion: The Windows evidence identifies the frozen Core Ring Tier 1 surface and proves no hosted-registry or arbitrary external-host claim.
The Windows evidence records bounded raw-byte stdio initialize/list/call/error behavior for one in-process Garnet tool.
The exact candidate accepts the named sealed baseline and records its deterministic identity.
The same exact candidate rejects the unsealed or mismatched path fail-closed with a nonzero outcome.
A deterministic reporter binds all WV-6 outcomes and artifacts to one full candidate SHA.

scopeLimits: WV-6 is native Windows evidence for the bounded Garnet-owned Shelf path, not arbitrary MCP host enforcement.
WV-6 does not prove hosted registry, browser execution, production readiness, signing, release publication, or FIRE.
jonOnlyActions: Approve any base-merge gate or integrity-policy change required by the Shelf candidate.
Decide whether WV-6 evidence is sufficient for launch-scope claim promotion.
Decide FIRE versus HOLD and perform any tag, release publication, or public launch action outside this acceptance gate.

contracts.title: winget/scoop dry-run + devcontainer/Docker + installer happy-path distribution proof

authoritySources.authority: WV-7 owns winget/scoop dry-run, devcontainer/Docker, and installer happy-path proof.
Windows CLI distribution remains deferred until exact package-manager and installer evidence exists.

entryConditions: One exact candidate and its Windows release artifacts are frozen.
Dry-run manifests reference that exact candidate's artifacts and hashes.
Container and installer exercises use clean, recorded environments.

requiredChecks.criterion: A local winget manifest validate/install dry-run is recorded against the exact candidate without claiming upstream publication.
A local Scoop bucket manifest install/uninstall dry-run is recorded against the exact candidate without claiming public bucket publication.
The exact candidate builds and runs through the committed devcontainer happy path.
The exact candidate builds and runs through the committed Docker happy path with bounded output.
A clean Windows install, CLI smoke, and uninstall transcript is recorded for the exact candidate.

scopeLimits: Dry-run validation is not winget-pkgs acceptance, public Scoop publication, signed MSI, Authenticode, or SmartScreen reputation.
Container proof is distribution reproducibility evidence, not native Linux desktop or OS-sandbox enforcement.
WV-7 does not tag, publish, announce, or declare production readiness.
jonOnlyActions: Provision or authorize any signing credential needed beyond the dry-run boundary.
Submit or publish to upstream winget or public Scoop channels.
Approve the base-merge gate and promo QA signoff.
Decide FIRE versus HOLD and perform any tag, release publication, or launch announcement.
